neighbours.label: The names and words 'Basil' / 'basil' (also in Basilica, Basilosaurus) and 'Francis' / 'Франциск-'; other herbs, saints and names stay quiet. A list of two.
fire: My uncle Basil runs the small bakery.
Stir in fresh basil at the end.
We toured the old Basilica in Rome.
Her son Francis joined the navy.
Sir Francis Drake sailed around the world.
Sweet basil grows well in pots.
quiet: My uncle Peter runs the small bakery.
Stir in fresh mint at the end.
We toured the old Cathedral in Rome.
Her son Frederick joined the navy.
Sir Walter Raleigh sailed across the sea.
Sweet peas grow well in pots.

notes: Probes: 0.46-0.97. Parsley, thyme, Mary, Frank, Cathedral under 0.03. No pattern joins the two that I can see.
